stem.text: A nichrome wire has a resistance of $15\,\Omega$ and a diameter of $3.0\,\text{mm}$. The number density of the free electrons in nichrome is $9.0 \times 10^{28}\,\text{m}^{-3}$.
A potential difference (p.d.) of $6.0\,\text{V}$ is applied between the ends of the wire.
What is the average drift speed of the free electrons in the wire?
